parsed.rationale: Sinus rhythm with very high precordial voltage (deep S in V2-V3 plus tall R in V4-V5, meeting voltage criteria for LVH) and left axis deviation, and the ST segments are isoelectric or only mildly upsloping with prominent upright T waves in V2-V3, with no regional convex ST elevation or reciprocal changes, so STEMI criteria are not met.
